name: @papercusp/coordination
description: Agent coordination substrate, extracted as three host-agnostic pieces: coord-core (pure envelope types + identity-free fold/merge/glob protocol logic), CoordEventLog (the swappable append-only channel-log seam — fs default + in-memory double, covers messages/handoffs/escalations/plan-events), and PresenceStore (the live-presence seam over an injected PgHandle). No @papercusp/@restart runtime deps; identity, subscriptions, and watermark persistence stay host-side by design.
